data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: recipe
sections.summary: A set of instructions for preparing and cooking a particular dish.

senses.definition: a set of instructions describing how to prepare and cook a particular dish, including a list of ingredients
examples: She found an easy recipe for banana bread online.

answers.answer: A recipe is a restaurant worker.

sections.question: refreshment
sections.summary: Food and drink provided at an event, or something that restores energy.

senses.definition: food and drink provided at an event or meeting; also used in the plural 'refreshments' to refer to light snacks and drinks served at a gathering
examples: Light refreshments were available during the interval.

answers.answer: Light refreshments were served after the meeting.
Light refreshment were served after meeting.
A refreshment is a cooking instruction.

sections.question: selection
sections.summary: A range or variety of things available to choose from.

senses.definition: a range or variety of things available to choose from; a group of items that have been chosen
examples: The bakery offers an impressive selection of breads and pastries.

answers.answer: The restaurant offers a wide selection of desserts.
The restaurant offers wide selection of desserts.
A selection is a cooking ingredient.

sections.question: snack
sections.summary: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.

senses.definition: a small amount of food eaten between main meals, or a small portion of food eaten quickly
examples: She had a snack of fruit and yoghurt in the afternoon.

answers.answer: He had a snack between meals.
A snack is a full dinner.

sections.question: specialty
sections.summary: A particular food or dish that a place or chef is especially famous for.

senses.definition: a particular food or dish that a place, chef, or region is especially known for and does particularly well
examples: The paella is the chef's specialty and is always in high demand.

answers.answer: A specialty is a type of spoon.

sections.question: starter
sections.summary: The first course of a meal, served before the main course.

senses.definition: the first course of a meal, typically a small dish served before the main course
examples: For a starter, he chose the soup of the day.

answers.answer: We ordered a starter before the main course.
We ordered starter before main course.
A starter is the final dessert.

sections.question: sweet
sections.summary: Having a taste like sugar; not sour, salty, or bitter.

senses.definition: having a taste like sugar; not sour, salty, or bitter; pleasant to the taste in a sugary way
examples: This mango is really sweet and juicy.

answers.answer: She prefers sweet food to savoury food.
Sweet is a type of restaurant.

sections.question: treat
sections.summary: Something special and enjoyable, especially an unusual or indulgent food.

senses.definition: something special and enjoyable, especially an unusual or indulgent food that you do not have very often
examples: A trip to the cinema and popcorn is always a great treat.

answers.answer: Ice cream is a special treat.
A treat is a cooking method.

sections.question: vegan
sections.summary: Not containing any animal products; relating to a diet that excludes all animal-derived foods.

senses.definition: not containing any animal products including meat, dairy, or eggs; relating to a lifestyle or diet that avoids all animal-derived foods
examples: The café offers a wide range of vegan dishes.

sections.question: vegetarian
sections.summary: Not eating or containing meat; relating to a diet or lifestyle that excludes meat.

senses.definition: not eating or containing meat or fish; relating to a diet or lifestyle that excludes meat
examples: There is always a vegetarian option on the school menu.

answers.answer: He is vegetarian, so he doesn't eat meat.
Vegetarian is a type of restaurant.
